run_assisted_generation: run assisted generation using a large Llama 405B model guided by an 8B assistant model
create_model_load_checkpoint: create a causal language model from a Hugging Face checkpoint with auto device mapping and float32 dtype
create_tokenizer_load: create a tokenizer from a Hugging Face checkpoint for encoding prompts and decoding generated tokens
run_model_generate_assisted: run model.generate with an assistant_model parameter to accelerate text generation via speculative decoding
run_tokenizer_batch_decode: run tokenizer.batch_decode on generated token outputs to produce human-readable text strings
